QC Description: "language" contains duplicate values
Message: "language" contains duplicate values [V112]
Expression:
WITH IndividualLanguage as (
    select  record_id,
            TRIM(FLATTEN(REGEXP_SPLIT("language", chr(59), 'ALL', 999))) as oneLanguage
    from    dataset_46377.dcMetadata
),

Duplicates as (
    select  IL.record_id
    from    IndividualLanguage IL
    group by IL.record_id, IL.oneLanguage
    having  count(*) > 1
)

select  M.record_id,
        M."language"
from    dataset_46377.dcMetadata M
join     Duplicates D 
ON M.record_id = D.record_id

QC Description: The value of documentCode must follow the syntax of WISE identifiers
Message: The value of documentCode must follow the syntax of WISE identifiers [V122]
Expression:
WITH Dataset AS (
    select  record_id,
            documentcode,
            (
            select  concat(
                    '^',
                    '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}',
                    '[0-9A-Z]{1}(([0-9A-Z]|\-(?![\-_])|_(?![\-_])){0,38}[0-9A-Z]{1}){0,1}$'
                )
            ) as regexp
    from   dataset_46377.Document
    where   coalesce(documentcode, '') <> ''
)
select  record_id,
        documentcode
from    Dataset
where   NOT REGEXP_COL_LIKE(documentcode, regexp)

QC Description: There are reference tables that have to be updated
Message: The following reference tables have to be updated: {%REFERENCE_TABLES%} . [RF9999] Please, contact helpdesk. [RF9999]
Expression:
WITH 
-- ============================================================================
-- 1. CHECK THE 'ProtectedArea' DATASET
-- ============================================================================
Expected_PA AS (
    SELECT  snapshotId AS expectedSnapshotId 
    FROM    dataset_46376.ReferenceMetadata 
    WHERE   countryCode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
            AND referenceTable = 'ProtectedArea'
),
Observed_PA AS (
    SELECT  DISTINCT snapshotId 
    FROM    dataset_46376.ProtectedArea 
    WHERE   countryCode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
),
Mismatch_PA AS (
    SELECT  CASE 
                WHEN O.snapshotId IS NULL THEN 'ProtectedArea is missing expected data: ' || E.expectedSnapshotId
                WHEN E.expectedSnapshotId IS NULL THEN 'ProtectedArea contains unexpected data: ' || O.snapshotId
            END AS validation_error
    FROM    Expected_PA E 
            FULL OUTER JOIN Observed_PA O 
                ON E.expectedSnapshotId = O.snapshotId 
    WHERE   O.snapshotId IS NULL OR E.expectedSnapshotId IS NULL
),

-- ============================================================================
-- 2. CHECK THE 'RelatedZone' DATASET
-- ============================================================================
Expected_RZ AS (
    SELECT  snapshotId AS expectedSnapshotId 
    FROM    dataset_46376.ReferenceMetadata 
    WHERE   countryCode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
            AND referenceTable = 'RelatedZone'
),
Observed_RZ AS (
    SELECT  DISTINCT snapshotId 
    FROM    dataset_46376.RelatedZone 
    WHERE   countryCode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
),
Mismatch_RZ AS (
    SELECT  CASE 
                WHEN O.snapshotId IS NULL THEN 'RelatedZone is missing expected data: ' || E.expectedSnapshotId
                WHEN E.expectedSnapshotId IS NULL THEN 'RelatedZone contains unexpected data: ' || O.snapshotId
            END AS validation_error
    FROM    Expected_RZ E 
            FULL OUTER JOIN Observed_RZ O 
                ON E.expectedSnapshotId = O.snapshotId 
    WHERE   O.snapshotId IS NULL OR E.expectedSnapshotId IS NULL
),

-- ============================================================================
-- COMBINE ALL RESULTS FOR REPORTNET 3 BLOCKER
-- ============================================================================

Mismatch AS (
    SELECT  LISTAGG(X.validation_error, ' / ') REFERENCE_TABLES
    FROM    (
            SELECT  validation_error FROM Mismatch_PA
            UNION ALL
            SELECT  validation_error FROM Mismatch_RZ
            ) X
    HAVING  count(*) > 0
)

SELECT  case 
            when length(REFERENCE_TABLES) > 3997
                then CONCAT (
                        left(left(REFERENCE_TABLES, 3997), 3997 - position('/' IN reverse(left(REFERENCE_TABLES, 3997))) + 1)
                        ,'...'
                        )
            else REFERENCE_TABLES
        end AS REFERENCE_TABLES,
        (select min(record_id) from dataset_46377.dcMetadata) as record_id
FROM    Mismatch
